text:
maria_support: Customer org_9876 reports free-trial credits not decrementing on long-lived streaming chat sessions. says their dashboard shows unchanged balance after several successful responses. ticket #SUP-12251.
@derek_billing @jordan_backend any quick ideas? :thinking:
derek_billing: Can you paste a minimal replay request and any trace IDs? I want to check ledger events.
maria_support: Repro steps I gave them:
1) Start streaming chat with \`/v1/chat/stream\` using api_key of trial user org_9876
2) Send ~3 incremental messages (client keeps open ws)
3) Close client gracefully (sends finalize event)
4) Dashboard still shows same free_trial_balance
Example request payload (sanitized):
```json
{"model":"redwood-lite-2.7b","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"short prompt"}],"client_session_id":"sess-42"}
```
Trace id from customer logs: `trace-20260301-9a7f2b` (they captured on client side)
jordan_backend: Thanks. Can you grab the service-side logs around finalize for that trace? I want to see if finalize webhook/WS ack reached billing service.
maria_support: Pasted relevant logs below (redacted):
```
[2026-03-01T14:02:11Z] chat-service: recv chunk, sess sess-42, trace trace-20260301-9a7f2b
[2026-03-01T14:02:13Z] chat-service: stream closed by client, emitting finalize event -> router
[2026-03-01T14:02:13Z] router: routed finalize to billing-v1 (request id req-7f2b)
[2026-03-01T14:02:13Z] billing-v1: enqueue debit job job-001
[2026-03-01T14:02:13Z] billing-v1: job-001 started
[2026-03-01T14:02:13Z] billing-v1: job-001 attempted debit -> DB deadlock, retry scheduled
[2026-03-01T14:02:13Z] telemetry: duplicate finalize event detected for sess-42
```
jordan_backend: Huh — deadlock then a duplicate finalize. telemetry flagged duplicate finalize events for same session. That could explain no debit if retry never committed. Derek, does billing-v1 mark retries in ledger idempotently? Could a deadlock leave the final state unset?
derek_billing: billing-v1 should be idempotent keyed by session id. However, if the first job failed after creating a provisional row and second job never cleaned up, the provisional row might not be promoted to a committed debit. I'll inspect job-001 logs and ledger rows.
opsbot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/billing-debits
maria_support: I've already asked customer to share their org user id: `user_444` and timestamp window 2026-03-01T14:02:00Z-14:05:00Z. They're available for a quick call if needed.
jordan_backend: Quick SQL I ran on a staging snapshot (example):
```sql
SELECT * FROM billing_ledger WHERE session_id='sess-42' ORDER BY created_at;
-- rows:
-- id | session_id | amount | status    | created_at
-- 101 | sess-42    | -15    | provisional | 2026-03-01T14:02:13Z
-- 102 | sess-42    | -15    | orphaned    | 2026-03-01T14:02:13Z
```
derek_billing: That matches my suspicion. provisional entry created, then job retried but failed to mark committed. The orphaned row left the ledger inconsistent and our dashboard only counts committed rows.
maria_support: Customer is upset because API returned full responses and they thought they were charged. They want either immediate debit or credit and an explanation.
derek_billing: Short-term: we can run a backfill that finds provisional rows older than 1m with successful finalize telemetry and promote them to committed after verifying no double-charge risk. I'll prepare a safe query and get approvals.
jordan_backend: Preventatively, I'll add stronger duplicate-finalize detection and make billing-v1 hold a DB-level advisory lock keyed on session_id before creating provisional rows to avoid deadlocks.
maria_support: ETA for backfill? Customer asked for update in 2 hours.
derek_billing: I'll queue the backfill, target run in 45 mins. @opsbot can you create a short maintenance flag and audit log entry before we mutate ledger rows? :lock:
opsbot: created ticket MIL-458 and audit entry. maintenance flag set to `billing-backfill-2067890123`.
maria_support: I'll message the customer with interim note: "Investigating, potential backfill to reconcile missing debits, ETA ~45-60m." :thumbsup:
jordan_backend: Also adding a regression test: simulate DB deadlock on first job and ensure retry path commits or rolls back cleanly. I'll open PR.
derek_billing: After backfill we should run a reconciliation for the org over last 24h to catch similar cases. I'll follow up with a report.
maria_support: Thanks all — leaving this thread open until resolved. Will post final postmortem snippet here.
-- end of thread --"
